events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Good news: we're refunding the $6.61 cancellation fee to you as a Ryde voucher. You cancelled about a minute and a half after you matched with a driver. A fee only applies when you cancel more than three minutes after matching, so this one shouldn't have been charged. The $6.61 voucher will be added to your Ryde account. Nothing changes on your account and no further action is needed from you.

DRIVER: We're letting you know that the $6.61 cancellation fee on this trip has been cancelled, so it won't be paid out. The rider cancelled about a minute and a half after matching. A cancellation fee only applies when the rider cancels more than three minutes after matching, so the arrival condition for the fee wasn't met. Nothing is held against your account, and no action is needed from you. Thanks for driving with Ryde.
